# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Ferrofolio does not publish its own releases yet. Until it does, security fixes are applied to the `develop` branch only.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately using
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/ferrofolio/ferrofolio/security/advisories/new).

If the vulnerability also affects the upstream project [Finanze](https://github.com/finanze/finanze), please report it
there as well.

Please do not open a public issue for security reports.

We will acknowledge your report as soon as possible.
